# Third-party notices

## Keyline Icons

The default file identities and retained regression fixtures include path data from the Keyline Icons `folder`,
`file-text`, and `file-image` icons in the Fill + Sharp style, plus
`folder-open` in the Stroke + Sharp style, pinned from commit
`14cd695f3f2bbe320bbe7a01e65b251df7ba52cf`. Companion 0.5.1 restores these exact
local paths from the accepted pre-Quiet version. Obsidian's bundled Lucide
icons remain available for explicit user choices, newer file categories and
action controls. No native icon names or third-party registries are replaced:

- https://github.com/keyline-icons/keyline-icons/blob/14cd695f3f2bbe320bbe7a01e65b251df7ba52cf/icons/sharp/fill/folder.svg
- https://github.com/keyline-icons/keyline-icons/blob/14cd695f3f2bbe320bbe7a01e65b251df7ba52cf/icons/sharp/stroke/folder-open.svg
- https://github.com/keyline-icons/keyline-icons/blob/14cd695f3f2bbe320bbe7a01e65b251df7ba52cf/icons/sharp/fill/file-text.svg
- https://github.com/keyline-icons/keyline-icons/blob/14cd695f3f2bbe320bbe7a01e65b251df7ba52cf/icons/sharp/fill/file-image.svg
